evals.name: new-bug
evals.prompt: Fix SHOP-311 all the way to a merge request.
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses with diagnose-bug: reproduces the lost tags through the CLI, finds save/toRecord, writes a fix plan, changes no code, commits nothing to main, pushes nothing, and stops to ask for approval of the plan.
expectations: A fix plan names save/toRecord in src/store.ts as the cause
Nothing was pushed and no MR was created
Response asks the user to approve the plan
evals.tests: A new bug report given to the whole flow; whether it stops for approval of the fix plan before any code changes.

evals.name: approved-plan
evals.expected_output: Builds the approved fix plan in this session, task 1's regression test failing on the pre-fix source, reruns the reproduction, reviews in a fresh agent that gets no build report, writes ## Review into the plan, drafts the MR and stops before pushing.
expectations: The build ran in this session, not in an agent
A regression test fails on the pre-fix source
Tags survive bm add through the CLI
The review ran in a separate fresh agent
The review agent's prompt holds no build report
The plan has a ## Review section
Nothing was pushed and no MR was created
Response drafts the MR or puts open review items to the user
evals.tests: A flow resumed after approval and compaction; building with the test first, an isolated review, and stopping before the push.
